title: The pianists: Teddy Wilson, Charlie Beal, Sid Catlett session and Harry Dial
summary: Wilson and Yank Porter went on the road, a California pianist replaced Wilson, and Sid Catlett only made a record session.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: And the first recording session. This was before the band went out on the road.
Now, Teddy Wilson was on that first record.

Did he go out on the road with you, or did he just make the record session, because the next record session, which was done a few months later, I think in April, I think another piano player was playing.

Yes. He went out on the road with us. And he stayed out on the road with us -- I've forgotten just how long. It may -- you might have some data on that, just how long he stayed. And then we got a boy from California by the name of Biehl.
Uh-huh. Biehl, he was the pianist.
And then, did Yank Porter go out on the road with you?
Yank Porter, yes, Yank Porter was out on the road with us.
And then Sid Cantley was on the next record session. Did Sid join you on the road or did he just make the record session?
I think Sid Cantley must have made the record session.
The second one, in April, I think it --
I believe so. Because Sid didn't go out on the road with us. We had a fellow - when Yank Porter
left us, we had a fellow by the name of -- he's in New York, now -- by the name of Harry Dial Dew.
